name: Bourbon
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR (32.5%), REFINED (PALM & PALMOLEIN) OIL, EDIBLE STARCH, COLOURS [150a, 150c, 150d, 122, 110, 133 & 102], WHEY POWDER, COCOA SOLIDS (1.5%), NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL (VANILLA, MILKY COCOA & CHOCOLATE) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, RAISING AGENTS [500(ii) & 503(ii)), EMULSIFIERS [322(1) & 471], MILK CHOCOLATE (0.1%) [EMULSIFIER [322(1)] AND NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES] AND IODISED SALT.
